premise: F-rank porter Kang Do-yoon dies in the Seoul Collapse ten years from now and wakes on the morning of his awakening measurement at twenty-seven. He knows the Collapse's mastermind, "the Watcher", is Hunter Association Chairman Yoon Jae-kyung—and he cannot prove it. He builds power quietly to stop the Collapse, but the future starts to slip every time he intervenes.

genre.notes: Regression devices strong; romance as a slow-burn subplot.

main_character.name: Kang Do-yoon
main_character.description: 27. Spent ten years at the bottom as an F-rank porter before dying in the Collapse. Cold, terse. Uses future knowledge as a weapon but cannot prove any of it, so he always moves quietly.
main_character.speech_notes: Polite-neutral by default. Blunt with juniors. Fully formal with chairmen and Association executives.

supporting_characters.name: Lee Seo-ha
supporting_characters.description: 24, B-rank healer. Hides that she is a conglomerate chairman's illegitimate daughter.
supporting_characters.speech_notes: Polite and precise with everyone; first names with Do-yoon only from ch.87.

supporting_characters.name: Park Mu-jin
supporting_characters.description: 45, C-rank veteran hunter. Died shielding Do-yoon in the previous life.
supporting_characters.speech_notes: Gruff and informal downward; proverbs; calls Do-yoon 'son' when serious.

supporting_characters.name: Choi Hyun-seok
supporting_characters.description: 31, A-rank, Vice-Guildmaster of White Night. Polished; never raises his voice.

supporting_characters.name: Han Yu-ri
supporting_characters.speech_notes: Eager and polite to seniors; slips into casual speech when excited.

world_concept: Modern Seoul decades after the gates opened. The Association measures awakened people on an F–S scale. No status windows—only measurement-device readings. Mana-stone economy.
forbidden_developments: Do-yoon telling anyone about the regression before ch.58
The Watcher's identity being revealed before ch.120
Any confession or physical intimacy before ch.87

target_audience.description: Adult readers of English-language serialized fiction in the Korean webnovel tradition

progression_system: Association ranks F–S determined by measurement-device readings; growth through dungeon clears and mana-stone absorption. Do-yoon's edge is regression knowledge plus a late awakening, not precognition.

mandatory_scenes.description: Chapter 1 opens on the measurement device showing F.
The Gangnam gate break happens differently from the original history.

prose_preferences: Hindsight monologue at most 20% of a chapter

naming_preferences.notes: Family name first, hyphenated given names (Kang Do-yoon).

terminology_preferences.notes: hunter, gate, awakened, mana stone; 'Senior' + surname instead of sunbae.
